scenes.vo: In *1948*, a grocery boss asked: why is checkout so slow?
Every price was typed in by hand, one item at a time, while the line behind it kept growing.

params.text: A student, *Norman Woodland*, took it to the beach.

scenes.vo: So a young student, *Norman Woodland*, took that question with him to a beach in Florida.
He drew Morse code in the sand, then pulled its dots and dashes down into thin and thick lines. Patent: 1952.

params.label: FIRST SCAN AT A CHECKOUT
params.sub: Twenty two years after the patent

scenes.vo: The first real scan at a checkout came in *1974*, twenty two years later.

caption:
Who drew the first barcode in 1948?

A student took a supermarket's question to a Florida beach and drew Morse code in the sand.
